description: Reference intervals the briefing judges lab results against, keyed by LOINC. Used only when the report printed no usable range for a result, or to name a disagreement with the printed range. One row without sex is the default; sex-specific rows (M/F) are chosen by patient_data.sex, and an unknown sex takes the widest union. low/high are the normal interval; panic_low/panic_high mark critical values. Adults only. Every row is a clinical coding decision: cite the source and extend deliberately.
